Rafael: Heads up team 1 — SkylineHealth finalized a 12-month Dedicated + Private deployment via HealthCloud marketplace. Pilot moved to production today. Huge credit to Solutions + Eng. :tada:

June: Nice! ACV is $255k with an optional renewal. They migrated a latency-sensitive clinical routing feature. Need a short quote and logo permission for the case study.

Olivia: Marketing happy to run the case study. Can we get perf deltas and the exact config used in the pilot? Also asking for a 30s testimonial from the CTO if possible.

Sam: Tech summary: deployed with `redwood deploy --env private --region us-west-2 --pool dedicated-priv-1` using quantized-8bit and prefix KV caching. Baseline -> pilot: avg latency drop ~2.8x, cost per inference down ~42%. Sustained 90 QPS at p95 ~72ms for 384 tokens. I'll upload graphs to the shared drive.

KB (Legal): Need signed logo + testimonial release. HealthCloud wants co-branded marketplace tile; we'll need a Partner MSA addendum. I'll draft and share.

Rafael: Customer contact: Dr. Nina Shah, CTO  nina@skylinehealth.org. Suggested quote from pilot: "Redwood's Dedicated+Private setup gave us predictable latency and let us ship clinician-facing routing with confidence." Edit as needed.

Olivia: Thanks Rafael. Drafting case study and marketplace blurb. Timeline: draft by Wed, legal sign-off Fri, customer review early next week, publish with HealthCloud marketplace update ~10 business days post-signoff.

Sam: Small tech caveat: Skyline uses an internal logging adapter that inflates token counts by ~5%. We'll include a reproducibility note so numbers map to their stack.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace tile "healthcloud-skylinehealth" submitted at 2026-03-24T09:12:00Z  awaiting partner approval.

June: Stellar work. We'll hold company announcement until Legal and HealthCloud confirm copy. Schedule invites please. :rocket:
